snippet.title: Honey Badger Don't Die [Trailer]
snippet.description:
HONEY BADGER DONT DIE!
Our game is about a man who wakes up in an unfamiliar place, and the only way to escape is with the help of a genetically modified honey badger that has bitten off his toe. 

To escape, you’ll have to find your way through the corridors of a research complex, which will be filled with obstacles. The key to overcoming them is the honey badger,
 with whom you’ll have to befriend. Thanks to the standard ‘Drag`o`Matic’ mixing station, you can synthesise compounds to alter the honey badger’s physical properties, 
making it invulnerable. To achieve good results, you’ll have to experiment with the ingredients found at the station.
Look for a way out, explore new recipes and try to figure out what happened.

We present the “Drag`O`Matic” standard raw sample mixing station. 
To begin, draw the substance from the dispenser and load it into the station via the sample inlet. Repeat this step to load the other two inlets.  
“Golden Rule”: In a single compound, all three inlets must be loaded with different substances, with no duplicates! If a mistake is made, 
the inlets are cleared using the corresponding button. 
Once all three inlets are loaded with different substances and vessels are placed under the taps, you can start the mixing process using the corresponding button.
 The resulting compound can be tested on a honey badger. 
The result of the effect on the organism is recorded in a log. In this way, you must identify useful recipes and filter out those that are useless. 
The number of possible combinations increases significantly as new substances become available for mixing.
